text:
alex: Heads-up — doing a small canary for the base-image rebuild tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Primary goals: ensure KMS-attested layers verify cleanly, RBAC changes don't block the signer, and audit logs contain cosign verification events. Anyone on call for quick triage?

sam: I can be there for the canary window. What's the expected duration?

alex: Thanks. Expect ~30–45m for the initial push, then 1h for verification & smoke. We'll roll a single worker cluster first.

priya: Quick checklist request: will the keystore role be using the new tight-binding policy (svc-keystore-attest) or the fallback role? Need to update our ServiceAccount bindings if it's the new one.

alex: We'll use svc-keystore-attest. It's necessary for envelope unwraps. Priya — can you confirm you own the RBAC change PR?

priya: Yep, I'll open the PR after lunch and tag reviewers. Will include the exact role YAML here.

secops-bot: Incident 2026-03-23-4410 created: image-canary-keystore-verify. Runbook: /runbooks/image-attest-canary. Assigned to: ops-oncall.

morgan: /cc @ops-oncall make sure the auditpipe is routing cosign verification lines to the security index. Last time we missed signature metadata in logs.

ops-oncall: Roger. I'll validate auditpipe rules pre-canary. If we see gaps, I can flip a shim that duplicates cosign stdout to audit-log until fix.

jin: One gotcha: when we switched to multi-kms keyrings, cosign verify needs the key path mapping. I'll drop a short snippet you can run to verify artifacts locally:

```bash
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/attest/cryptoKeys/cosign 
```

jin: If the key isn't available due to RBAC, cosign returns 403 but exits 0? I forget. Test it ahead.

luis: Also double-check the fallback signer queue. If the primary keywrap fails, we should avoid autoswitching to the older unsigned image. Can we gate rollout on verification success?

alex: Yes — rollout will stop on verification failures. Plan: canary push -> post-push hook runs cosign verify -> webhook to CI marks pass/fail. If fail, automated rollback and alert.

sam: What's the mitigation if auditable metadata is missing but verification passes? We still need provenance in Elastic for SRE debugging.

morgan: We should add a one-off job that scrapes the image manifest and emits structured events: cosign metadata, KMS keyid, build-id, git-commit. That job can run post-canary and feed the same pipeline.

priya: For RBAC, I'm adding a note to the PR: bind only `get`/`decrypt` to the signer SA, not list/admin. That'll appease compliance.

ops-oncall: Preflight tasks I will run 1h before: validate RBAC bindings, run jin's cosign snippet against a known-good image, check auditpipe routing, and confirm rollback hook wired.

secops-bot: Reminder: Security sprint freeze window in effect 03/24 00:00-06:00 UTC — coordinate if you need extra access.

alex: Good catch. Our canary is 09:00 UTC so outside freeze. Still be mindful of any policy changes.

jin: If anyone wants to run a local test image, ping me and I'll share ephemeral access to the key for dev verification.

luis: After canary, let's schedule a quick 15m postmortem + verify logs exist in Security index. If all good, we scale to canary-3 and then full fleet.

alex: Perfect. I'll send calendar invites and the PR link once priya opens it. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
